**§4.2.2 Debt service**

Policy requires pro forma DSCR at origination of at least 1.25x. Any request below that is a policy exception [D4, §4.2.2]. On an FY2025 basis, pro forma DSCR is 1.38x [D1, §3], which is above 1.25x on the stated figures [D1, §3; D4, §4.2.2].

**§4.2.3 Senior review**

Senior underwriter review and Senior Loan Committee approval are required for new-money requests where (a) total commitment exceeds $15.0 million, (b) pro forma total leverage exceeds 3.00x, or (c) any policy exception is present [D4, §4.2.3].

- **Trigger (b):** Pro forma total leverage is 2.52x [D1, §3]. On the stated figures, this does not exceed the 3.00x threshold [D1, §3; D4, §4.2.3].
- **Trigger (c):** No policy exception under §4.2.1 or §4.2.2 appears on the stated figures [D1, §3; D4, §4.2.1, §4.2.2].

**§4.2.4 Concentration**

Policy requires the credit memo to address customer concentration in Section 7 if any single customer exceeds 25% of borrower revenue in the most recent fiscal year [D4, §4.2.4]. Customer A accounted for 31% of FY2025 revenue [D1, §5], so the requirement is triggered on the stated figures [D1, §5; D4, §4.2.4]. Section 7 is underwriter-authored.

**§4.2.5 Risk rating**

Each credit memo needs a 1-10 risk rating with a written rationale in Section 9. The underwriter assigns the rating and the senior reviewer confirms it [D4, §4.2.5].
